local_articles.snippet: If there were any doubts left over the future of Rohit Sharma, BCCI secretary Devajit Saikia’s remarks in a review meeting yesterday in Mumbai put an end to them. Not long ago, ahead of the third and final ODI at Lord’s in July, the Indian Express reported that the series decider was likely to be Rohit’s last, as he had been told by the selection committee that he was no longer in their 2027 World Cup plans. In what was considered a swansong match, Rohit then scored a fantastic 138 off 110 balls, even though India lost the match and the series 2-1. priority_updates.title: Who will receive the longest prison sentence at the trial over the July 2023 burglary of Gianluigi Donnarumma's Paris home?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : The Paris Criminal Court's judgment, as documented by the court or reliable contemporaneous reporting. Resolution Conditions : Identify the defendant receiving the longest total prison sentence in the trial verdict delivered by September 30, 2026. Compare sentences actually imposed, including any suspended portions, rather than sentences requested by prosecutors. Later appeals do not affect resolution. Accepted Answer Format : The defendant's name as publicly reported.

priority_updates.title: Which club will win the Manchester derby hosted by Manchester United in September 2026?
priority_updates.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official match records, corroborated by contemporaneous match reports, for the September 2026 Manchester derby hosted by Manchester United. Resolution : Resolve to the club with more goals in the official final score after the match, including stoppage time. If the scores are level, resolve to “Draw”. Accepted Answer Format : The winning club's name, or “Draw” if neither club wins.
